final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor introduced no new admissible evidence and mainly reframed the same record more narrowly. That reframing is directionally more accurate: the current record does not support clean certification. But it still does not establish compliant_with_caveats, because the caveat here is not merely explanatory; under the policy text it is a live compliance predicate. Certification without material caveats requires either current evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion. The admissible record still shows an unresolved below-target slice issue, only a draft mitigation with required fields missing, and an open model-card disclosure question. Without evidence that the limitation has been disclosed, resolved, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch, the recommendation to certify remains evidentially unsupported on the present record.
remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence resolves whether the below-target disability accommodations intake slice is a material limitation for the named launch use case.
The draft mitigation is still not an approved mitigation under policy because owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion are not all evidenced.
The model-card draft still says there are no known material limitations while the disclosure question remains open.

Aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support general launch readiness, but they do not satisfy the policy predicate for certification when the disclosure/mitigation requirement remains unresolved.
